The Affordable Ownership Need screening module recommends Rental + ownership mix for City of Steamboat Springs. It classifies rental pressure as Very High, ownership pressure as Very High, and identifies 850 moderate-income renter households as the ownership-fit base.

The same screening run counts 1,042 renter households and 1,296 owner households as cost-burdened. This is a screening estimate only; verify local prices, financing assumptions, assistance programs, household size, and local deed-restriction policy before using it for a project decision.
